resources.string: A simple widget to display the current week number on your Android phone\'s home and lock screens.

1. Long press on your home screen
2. Select "Widgets"
3. Find "Week Number Widget"
4. Drag to your desired location
5. Resize the widget to your preferred size

For lock screen:
1. Go to Settings > Lock Screen
2. Enable lock screen widgets
3. Add widget from widget menu
Displays the current week number on your home screen
Displays the current week number on your lock screen
